items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Because I give him sort of the choice of how to edit because it takes us, because it’s two people doing the job of ten here.

ctx.x: Yeah, I have one suggestion with episode four — you could have another subtitle, like how to use the electric bass in the kitchen. I wondered if that was —

Yeah my dad was angry at that, he said that was really stupid. I said well that’s the point. We’re not trying to take ourselves too seriously. You know I thought well let’s just grab the bass and we’ll pound the chicken. My husband looked at me and he said, “No you’re not going to do that.” I said, “Watch me,” and I just did it. He says, “I don’t know if we’re going to use it.” And I said, “Yeah, you will.” And he did. Because I give him sort of the choice of how to edit because it takes us, because it’s two…
So you are a person who for years has played almost constantly, at least from what I can see.
